whatIs.title: What is Code Screenshot?
whatIs.description: Code Screenshot is a developer tool that transforms code snippets into beautiful, shareable images suitable for social media, tech blogs, and presentations. Customize the editor theme, syntax highlighting by language, background gradient, and font size to create polished, professional-looking code visuals.

items.a: Most major languages are supported including JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java, C/C++, Go, Rust, SQL, HTML, CSS, and Markdown.

items.q: Can I adjust the output image resolution?
items.a: Yes. Choose from 1x, 2x, or 3x scale for high-resolution output. 2x or higher looks sharp on retina displays.

items.q: Can I set a transparent background?
items.a: Yes. Enable the transparent background option and export as PNG to get a code image with no background.
